newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank takes SKK 10bln tranche of 3 month bills.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank takes SKK 10bln tranche of 3 month bills.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Monday it had issued a 10 billion crown tranche of three-month liquidity bills into its own portfolio through a selected bank.
"We have issued the bills into our portfolio through a selected bank within the regular exchange of maturing issues," Dagmar Hrzanova, an NBS dealer, told Reuters.

Interbank money market dealers said they expected some five billion crowns worth of central bank bills from its portfolio to mature on Thursday, and some 10.4 billion crowns in central bank and finance ministry's bills this month.

The NBS repurchases its bills on a daily basis at a seven-day repo rate currently standing at 8.2 percent, and reverse repo at 7.4 percent. Both repo rates are the key price determining factors on the local money market.
